pictures.name: MGS1-Great-Sacrifice
pictures.prompt: Vast royal sacrifice grounds in ancient India: fire altars with rising smoke, priests chanting, heaps of gold coins, sacks of grain and herds of garlanded cows being given away to crowds. On a raised dais sits King Yudhishthira, a dignified man in his forties with a dark beard and a gold crown, in white and gold silk, giving generously. Bright gold sunlight, rich colors, grand and public. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: MGS2-Golden-Mongoose
pictures.prompt: In the middle of the royal sacrifice grounds in ancient India, a small brown mongoose whose head and one whole side of its body shine like real gold, the other side ordinary brown fur, stands up on its hind legs on the packed earth, as if speaking. Around it priests and nobles in silk stare in astonishment. In the background, on his dais, King Yudhishthira, a dignified man in his forties with a dark beard and a gold crown, in white and gold silk, leans forward, surprised. Gold light glinting on the mongoose. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: MGS3-Poor-Family
pictures.prompt: A tiny mud hut in dry, cracked fields during a famine in ancient India, at dusk. Inside, sitting on the bare floor around one small clay bowl of barley flour divided into four little portions, a poor family of four: a thin, gentle old man with a white beard and a sacred thread in a worn white dhoti, his wife in a faded saffron sari, their grown son in a plain white dhoti, and the son’s young wife in a faded green sari. Thin but gentle faces, one small oil lamp glowing gold, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: MGS4-The-Guest
pictures.prompt: The doorway of a tiny mud hut in ancient India at dusk. a hungry traveler in a dusty brown shawl, thin and tired, with a strangely calm, kind face, stands at the door. The old man of a thin, gentle old man with a white beard and a sacred thread in a worn white dhoti, his wife in a faded saffron sari, their grown son in a plain white dhoti, and the son’s young wife in a faded green sari, rises to welcome him, holding out his own small portion of barley flour on a leaf, the others watching. Warm lamplight inside, blue dusk outside. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. pictures.name: MGS5-Last-Share
pictures.prompt: Inside a tiny mud hut in ancient India by lamplight. a hungry traveler in a dusty brown shawl, thin and tired, with a strangely calm, kind face, sits eating from leaf plates as a thin, gentle old man with a white beard and a sacred thread in a worn white dhoti, his wife in a faded saffron sari, their grown son in a plain white dhoti, and the son’s young wife in a faded green sari, offer him their last portions with open hands. A little spilled barley flour on the floor glows faintly gold. At the doorway, a small ordinary brown mongoose peeks in. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows, tender and holy.
